description: Orchestrator-level code review loop with conversation resumption for ralf run

items.user_story: As the orchestrator, I can capture the session ID from a Claude print-mode session so I can resume it later
items.description: Add --output-format json to spawnPrintMode, parse the JSON response to extract session_id and result text, and add a spawnResume function that uses --resume <id> -p <prompt> --output-format json
items.end_state: spawnPrintMode returns sessionId parsed from JSON output. spawnResume(sessionId, prompt) spawns claude --resume <id> -p <prompt> --output-format json and returns a SpawnResult with sessionId. Both functions use the same process group cleanup pattern.
steps_to_verify: spawnPrintMode return type includes sessionId: string | null
spawnPrintMode adds --output-format json to spawn args
spawnPrintMode parses JSON response to extract session_id and result fields
spawnResume function exists and uses --resume flag with session ID
spawnResume returns SpawnResult with sessionId
Both functions use detached process groups with SIGTERM cleanup
Unit tests verify session ID parsing from sample JSON output
npm run typecheck passes
npm run test passes

items.user_story: As a run agent, I implement and verify but don't commit, so the orchestrator can insert a review step before finalization
items.description: Split ralf-run into two skills: ralf-run (Steps 1-4: pick, claim, implement, feedback loops) and ralf-finalize (Steps 6-9: update progress, update PRD, commit, check completion). Remove the code review step from ralf-run entirely.
items.end_state: ralf-run SKILL.md ends after feedback loops pass — no code review step, no commit. ralf-finalize SKILL.md covers progress update, PRD update, commit, and completion check. Both are installed by ralf init.
steps_to_verify: ralf-run SKILL.md contains Steps 1-4 only (pick, claim, implement, feedback loops)
ralf-run SKILL.md does NOT mention committing or code review
ralf-finalize SKILL.md exists at .claude/skills/ralf-finalize/SKILL.md
ralf-finalize SKILL.md covers Steps 6-9 (progress, PRD, commit, completion)
ralf-finalize SKILL.md references the PRD item context so the agent knows what to finalize
skills.ts installs both ralf-run and ralf-finalize
npm run build succeeds

items.user_story: As a reviewer agent, I receive a git diff and PRD item context and output structured findings or LGTM
items.description: Create ralf-review skill that instructs the agent to run git diff, evaluate uncommitted changes against security/quality/completeness criteria, and output either <ralfie>LGTM</ralfie> or structured findings
items.end_state: ralf-review SKILL.md exists at .claude/skills/ralf-review/SKILL.md. It instructs the agent to evaluate the diff against review criteria and output <ralfie>LGTM</ralfie> when clean or structured findings when issues exist. Installed by ralf init.
steps_to_verify: ralf-review SKILL.md exists in .claude/skills/ralf-review/
Skill includes review criteria for security, code quality, and completeness
Skill instructs agent to output <ralfie>LGTM</ralfie> when no critical/warning findings
Skill instructs agent to output findings with file, line, severity, and suggestion when issues exist
skills.ts installs ralf-review alongside other skills
npm run build succeeds

items.user_story: As a user running ralf run, each PRD item is automatically reviewed by an independent agent before being committed, with up to 3 fix rounds
items.description: Wire the implement → review → fix → finalize loop into run.ts. After implementor exits, spawn reviewer with git diff context. If not LGTM, resume implementor with findings. Loop up to review_rounds times. Then resume implementor with ralf-finalize prompt.
items.end_state: run.ts per-iteration flow: (1) spawn implementor with ralf-run and capture sessionId, (2) spawn reviewer with ralf-review and git diff, (3) if not LGTM, resume implementor with findings via --resume, loop to step 2 (max config.review_rounds), (4) resume implementor with ralf-finalize to commit. All orchestrated in run.ts.
steps_to_verify: run.ts spawns implementor with spawnPrintMode and captures sessionId
run.ts spawns reviewer as a separate process after implementor exits
run.ts checks reviewer output for <ralfie>LGTM</ralfie>
If not LGTM, run.ts resumes implementor with review findings via spawnResume
Review loop is capped at config.review_rounds (default 3)
After review passes or max rounds, run.ts resumes implementor with ralf-finalize prompt
When review_enabled is false, run.ts skips review and goes straight to finalize
npm run typecheck passes
npm run test passes

items.user_story: As a user, I can configure the max review rounds and disable review entirely if needed
items.description: Add review_rounds (default 3) and review_enabled (default true) to RalfieConfig type and config defaults
items.end_state: RalfieConfig in shared/src/types.ts has review_rounds: number and review_enabled: boolean. defaultConfig in config.ts sets review_rounds: 3 and review_enabled: true. run.ts reads these values. Tests cover defaults.
steps_to_verify: RalfieConfig type includes review_rounds: number and review_enabled: boolean
defaultConfig sets review_rounds: 3, review_enabled: true
run.ts uses config.review_rounds for the loop cap
run.ts skips the review loop entirely when review_enabled is false
Existing config files without these fields get defaults via spread
npm run typecheck passes
npm run test passes
